scenarios.title: A｜正常预约
scenarios.setting: 玩家打电话给诊所预约看医生。

turns.text: Good morning, Riverside Clinic. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to make an appointment to see a doctor.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to make an appointment to see a doctor.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I’d like to book an appointment, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to book an appointment, please.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: Do you have any appointments available this week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any appointments available this week?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’d like to see a doctor about a headache I’ve been having.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to see a doctor about a headache I’ve been having.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I want to reserve a doctor.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to make an appointment to see a doctor.
feedback.explanation: “reserve a doctor”像在预留一个人；预约就诊常说“make an appointment with a doctor”。

turns.text: Of course. Is this for a new problem or a follow-up?

turns.prompt: 你想说明这次预约是初诊还是复诊，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a new problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a new problem.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s about something that’s been bothering me for a few days.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s about something that’s been bothering me for a few days.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: It’s a follow-up appointment.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a follow-up appointment.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I’ve been having headaches for the past few days.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been having headaches for the past few days.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

turns.text: We have an opening Thursday at 10:30. Would that work for you?

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, that works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Thursday at 10:30 is fine.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thursday at 10:30 is fine.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: That should work. How early should I arrive?

feedback.naturalExpression: That should work. How early should I arrive?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: Please arrive about fifteen minutes early.

turns.prompt: 关于「预约医生」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ll be there. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll be there. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜没有近期号源
scenarios.setting: 在“预约医生”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“没有近期号源”。

turns.text: Hi, I’d like to make an appointment sometime this week.
I’m sorry, but we’re fully booked this week.

turns.prompt: 你想了解最早可以约到的就诊时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: What’s the earliest appointment you have available?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the earliest appointment you have available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Do you have anything available next week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available next week?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Are there any cancellations I could take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any cancellations I could take?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Is there a waiting list I could be added to?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a waiting list I could be added to?
feedback.explanation: “waiting list”是候补名单；没有现成名额时，可以询问能否登记候补。

choices.text: You don’t have any time this week?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the earliest appointment you have available?
feedback.explanation: 医生预约空位通常问“any appointments available”；“any time”较泛，也容易像在追问对方是否有空。

turns.text: The earliest regular appointment is next Tuesday.

turns.prompt: 你想在近期约不到号时商量候补或其他时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is there any chance I could be seen sooner if someone cancels?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any chance I could be seen sooner if someone cancels?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Okay. Could you put me down for Tuesday for now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you put me down for Tuesday for now?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: My symptoms are getting worse. Is there another option you recommend?

feedback.naturalExpression: My symptoms are getting worse. Is there another option you recommend?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: I can book Tuesday and add you to the cancellation list.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That would be great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Perfect. Please let me know if anything opens up sooner.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Please let me know if anything opens up sooner.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

scenarios.title: C｜修改预约
scenarios.setting: 在“预约医生”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“修改预约”。

turns.text: Hi, I’m calling about an appointment I have tomorrow.
Sure. What would you like to change?

turns.prompt: 关于「预约医生」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I need to reschedule it, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to reschedule it, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Something came up, so I won’t be able to make it tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Something came up, so I won’t be able to make it tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “won't be able to make it”在约时间的语境中表示无法到场或能否赴约，不是字面的“制作”。

choices.text: Could I move my appointment to another day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I move my appointment to another day?
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: Do you have anything available later this week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available later this week?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I want to change my appointment to another time.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I need to reschedule it, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 这句能清楚表达改时间；“reschedule my appointment”更简洁，也准确指改约。

turns.text: We have Friday morning or Monday afternoon.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Friday morning would be better. What times do you have?

feedback.naturalExpression: Friday morning would be better. What times do you have?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could I take the Friday appointment?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I take the Friday appointment?
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: What time is the Monday appointment?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time is the Monday appointment?
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That works. Thank you for changing it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works. Thank you for changing it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll see you Friday at 9:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll see you Friday at 9:30.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。
